 Meet MOUZ: The IEM Beijing 2026 CS2 Champions
 Meet MOUZ, the IEM Beijing 2026 CS2 champions. Explore their roster, 3-0 Grand Final victory over The MongolZ, xertioN's MVP award and achievements. 
 10.11.2026 13 views 5 min read Mohammed Febin 
 Content Author
 View Profile 
 MOUZ have emerged as the champions of Intel Extreme Masters (IEM) Beijing 2026 after delivering a dominant performance against The MongolZ in the Counter-Strike 2 (CS2) Grand Final. The European esports organisation secured a convincing 3-0 victory to lift the prestigious trophy, ending their wait for another major ESL Pro Tour championship. 
 The tournament, which took place from November 2 to November 8 in Beijing, China, featured 16 of the world's best CS2 teams competing for a share of the $1.25 million prize pool. MOUZ were among the strongest contenders throughout the competition, completing an extraordinary undefeated campaign without dropping a single map. 
 Their victory also marked an important comeback after finishing as runners-up in the ESL Pro League Season 24 Grand Final just a month earlier. With this triumph, MOUZ have re-established themselves among the leading teams in competitive Counter-Strike. 
Who Are MOUZ in CS2?
 MOUZ, formerly known as mousesports, are a German esports organisation with a long history in competitive gaming. Founded in 2002, the organisation has competed across several esports titles, including Counter-Strike, League of Legends and other popular competitive games. 
 Their Counter-Strike division has established itself as one of the most respected teams in the international scene. Known for developing young talent and building competitive rosters, MOUZ have consistently challenged established organisations at major tournaments. 
 The organisation's latest success at IEM Beijing 2026 further strengthens its reputation as a championship contender in CS2. 
 MOUZ Roster: Players Behind the IEM Beijing 2026 Triumph
 MOUZ's championship-winning campaign was powered by a talented roster featuring experienced professionals and mechanically gifted players. 
 MOUZ featured a six-member lineup at IEM Beijing 2026, combining experienced Counter-Strike professionals with emerging talent. The roster was led by Dorian xertioN Berman, who delivered an outstanding tournament performance to earn the MVP award. Lotan Spinx Giladi and Ádám torzsi Torzsás also played important roles in the team's championship campaign. The remaining lineup featured xelex and PR, while Dennis sycrone Nielsen guided the squad as head coach. Together, they helped MOUZ secure an impressive 3-0 Grand Final victory over The MongolZ 
 The combination of individual skill, tactical discipline and international experience has helped MOUZ remain competitive against the strongest CS2 teams. 
 How MOUZ Won the IEM Beijing 2026 Championship
 MOUZ's journey to the IEM Beijing 2026 trophy was particularly impressive because of their consistency throughout the tournament. 
 They started strongly in the group stage, winning their matches and securing direct qualification for the playoff semifinals. Their flawless performances meant they avoided the quarterfinals and entered the knockout stage as one of the favourites. 
 In the semifinals, MOUZ faced BetBoom Team and secured a comfortable 2-0 victory to book their place in the Grand Final. 
 Their biggest challenge came against The MongolZ, who had already defeated several established teams and reached their first-ever IEM Grand Final. 
 However, MOUZ proved too strong in the championship showdown, winning all three maps: 
 - Mirage: MOUZ won 13-5. 
 - Dust2: MOUZ won 13-6. 
 - Inferno: MOUZ won 13-4. 
 The 3-0 victory completed an unbeaten tournament run, with MOUZ winning all 11 maps they played without conceding a single map to their opponents. 
 xertioN Named IEM Beijing 2026 MVP
 One of the biggest highlights of MOUZ's championship campaign was the individual performance of Dorian "xertioN" Berman. 
 The Israeli rifler was awarded the DHL MVP title after delivering exceptional performances throughout the competition. He recorded an impressive 47-32 kill-death record in the Grand Final alone, playing a crucial role in dismantling The MongolZ. 
 Interestingly, this was the first MVP award of xertioN's professional career, making the achievement even more special. 
 Teammate Lotan "Spinx" Giladi also delivered an outstanding Grand Final performance, finishing with a 46-27 kill-death record. 
 What Makes MOUZ Stand Out in Competitive CS2?
 MOUZ's biggest strength is their combination of individual firepower and structured team play. 
 Rather than relying entirely on individual brilliance, the team focuses on coordinated executes, effective utility usage and intelligent map control. 
 Their aggressive rifling, disciplined defensive setups and ability to adapt to opponents make them difficult to counter. The presence of experienced players also helps maintain composure during high-pressure rounds. 
 Another important factor is their ability to develop young talent and integrate it into a competitive system. This balance between individual potential and tactical discipline has helped MOUZ establish themselves among the world's elite CS2 teams. 
 MOUZ's Major Achievements and What Comes Next
 The IEM Beijing 2026 victory represents a significant milestone for MOUZ, particularly after their disappointing result in the ESL Pro League Season 24 Grand Final. 
 The championship also earned them their first ESL Pro Tour title since 2024 and their first point in the ESL Grand Slam VII race. 
 Here are some of the biggest highlights from their Beijing campaign: 
 - IEM Beijing 2026 Champions: Defeated The MongolZ 3-0 in the Grand Final. 
 - Unbeaten campaign: Won all 11 maps without dropping a single one. 
 - Tournament MVP: xertioN received his first career MVP award. 
 - Prize money: Secured $360,000 in total winnings, including $125,000 in player prize money and $235,000 for the organisation. 
 - ESL Grand Slam VII: Earned their first point in the competition. 
 Following their Beijing triumph, MOUZ will look to maintain their momentum in upcoming international tournaments, including the highly anticipated PGL Singapore Major. 
 Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
 1. Who are MOUZ in Counter-Strike 2?
 MOUZ are a German esports organisation competing in professional Counter-Strike 2. They are one of the most established teams in the international esports scene. 
 2. Did MOUZ win IEM Beijing 2026?
 Yes. MOUZ defeated The MongolZ 3-0 in the Grand Final on November 8, 2026, to become IEM Beijing champions. 
 3. Who did MOUZ defeat in the IEM Beijing 2026 Grand Final?
 MOUZ defeated Mongolian esports team The MongolZ with victories on Mirage, Dust2 and Inferno. 
 4. Who won the IEM Beijing 2026 MVP award?
 Dorian "xertioN" Berman from MOUZ received the DHL MVP award for his outstanding tournament performances. 
 5. How much prize money did MOUZ win at IEM Beijing 2026?
 MOUZ earned $360,000 in total winnings, consisting of $125,000 in player prize money and $235,000 in club rewards. 
 6. Which teams finished in the top three at IEM Beijing 2026?
 MOUZ finished first, The MongolZ secured second place, and Natus Vincere (NAVI) finished third.
